record.name: 消散的回忆
record.text: 亡语：&随机获取一张来自过去的法力值消耗为（5）的随从牌。
record.text_en: Deathrattle:& Get a random 5-Cost minion from the past.

face.name: 功夫大师
face.flavorText: 想学功夫？先交学费！

face.name: Grook Fu Master
face.flavorText: Grook Fu, the ancient Hozen art of bashing heads with a stick.

face.name: 沼泽爬行者
face.flavorText: 它以前被称作沼泽兽，但这个名字会让人迷惑，因为它根本不是野兽。

face.name: Fen Creeper
face.flavorText: He used to be called Bog Beast, but it confused people because he wasn't an actual beast. Boom, New Name!

face.name: 达拉然圣剑士
face.flavorText: 唯有甜甜圈可以让这位达拉然的执法者放慢脚步。

face.name: Dalaran Crusader
face.flavorText: Stops for nothing—except donuts.

face.name: 鬼灵骑士
face.flavorText: 精灵龙和鬼灵骑士有什么共同之处？它们的名字里都有“灵”字！

face.name: Spectral Knight
face.flavorText: What do Faerie Dragons and Spectral Knights have in common? They both love pasta!

face.name: 制毒师
face.flavorText: 要不是身患绝症想为家里留笔钱，她也不会走上这条路。

face.name: Venomancer
face.flavorText: Eight times the death of regular-mancers.

face.name: 血虫
face.flavorText: 兰娜瑟尔女王每天早餐都要吃上一条，必须炸得嘎嘣脆。

face.name: Bloodworm
face.flavorText: Queen Lana'thel insists on one of these, fried, every morning for breakfast.

face.name: 生锈的回收机器人
face.flavorText: 他有只蟑螂小伙伴，还有个会飞的女朋友。

face.name: Rusty Recycler
face.flavorText: Ironic. It could recycle others, but not itself.

face.name: 幽灵战马
face.flavorText: 前任恶灵骑士的坐骑。

face.name: Ghostly Charger
face.flavorText: Maybe we should have called him Ghostly Rusher.

face.name: 邪巢诱捕蛛
face.flavorText: 它本有志成为邪巢舞者的，无奈八条腿总踩到别人脚。

face.name: Vilebrood Skitterer
face.flavorText: It aspires to be a Vilebrood Dancer, but it has eight left feet.

face.name: 穴居人食菌者
face.flavorText: 他的呼吸中有着痛苦和绝望的味道。但仍然比大部分穴居人嘴里的气味要好。

face.name: Trogg Gloomeater
face.flavorText: His breath smells like agony and despair, which is still better than most troggs.

face.name: 闹闹机器人
face.flavorText: 音响设备全面升级，让我们燥起来！

face.name: Psych-o-Tron
face.flavorText: "Annoyinger-o-Tron" was just too unwieldy. And accurate.

face.name: 废土刺客
face.flavorText: 即便我的身体，眼睛和匕首都在发光，他们也不会发现我的到来。

face.name: Wasteland Assassin
face.flavorText: They'll never see me coming, what with my glowing body, eyes and daggers.

face.name: 消散的回忆
face.text: 亡语：&随机获取一张来自过去的法力值消耗为（5）的随从牌。
face.flavorText: 我想到了一条绝妙的卡牌趣文……怎么又忘了？

face.name: Fading Memory
face.text: Deathrattle:& Get a random 5-Cost minion from the past.
face.flavorText: I had the best idea for flavor text! …what was it again?
